subject: Remediation checkpoint: privilege escalation & exposed secrets evidence
messages:
From: BrightWave Assessments <reports@brightwave.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Redwood Inference - Pen test findings (privilege escalation, secrets exposure)

Hi Olga,

We completed the external penetration test for the public-facing inference endpoints for Acme Payments. Attached is the executive summary and the detailed findings (brightwave-pen-test-summary.pdf). Two findings require timely remediation and evidence for your SOC 2 and SIG submissions:

1) Privilege escalation chain (FND-PRIV-03) — through an API misconfiguration a low-privileged token can enumerate internal service metadata and escalate via an unvalidated role-assignment call. PoC included.
2) Exposed secrets via public S3 links (FND-SECR-07) — temporary artifacts with embedded API keys were discoverable for several hours.

We need confirmation of scope for remediation evidence (what controls you will apply), ETA for mitigation, and any evidence artifacts (remediation plan, logs, screenshots of fixed flows) once complete. Acme Payments' security team asked for an initial remediation ETA by 2026-11-04 to satisfy their procurement gate.

If useful, I can jump on a 30-minute call to walk through the PoCs.

Thanks,
Jacob Lee
Senior Tester, BrightWave Assessments
attachments: brightwave-pen-test-summary.pdf

----
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: BrightWave Assessments <reports@brightwave.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Pen test findings (privilege escalation, secrets exposure)

Jacob — thank you and team for the thorough report. We take these issues seriously and will treat FND-PRIV-03 and FND-SECR-07 as high priority.

Planned immediate actions:
- Privilege escalation (owner: Rishi) — block the role-assignment endpoint from unauthenticated callers, add server-side validation and RBAC checks, and instrument an audit event for any role-change attempts.
- Exposed secrets (owner: Vivek) — rotate the exposed keys, enforce S3 bucket ACLs and pre-signed URL TTLs, and add automated detection to our CI to fail on embedded keys.

Mina, can you coordinate evidence packaging for the Acme procurement team (SOC intake)? Rishi and Vivek — please provide ETA for remediation and a short list of evidence artifacts (logs, screenshots, rotated key IDs, PR links).

Olga
Director, Security Programs
Redwood Inference

> (see above)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, BrightWave Assessments <reports@brightwave.com>
Date: Sat, 7 Nov 2026 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Pen test findings (privilege escalation, secrets exposure)

Quick status update from infra:

- Secrets exposure (FND-SECR-07): keys implicated have been rotated (rotated-key-ids: rk-20261107-a / rk-20261107-b). Access logs show the pre-signed URLs were active for a 3-hour window; we've configured S3 policy to deny public ACLs for the affected buckets and set default pre-signed TTL to 15 minutes. CI check added (hook: detect-embedded-keys) — failing builds blocked.
Evidence items planned: rotated key IDs, S3 bucket ACL change diff, CloudTrail access logs for the object (scrubbed), CI pipeline screenshot.
ETA: 2026-11-10 EOD for completed evidence package.

- Privilege escalation (Rishi is driving detailed fix but infra changes to harden network surfaces are in progress): rate-limit the role assignment endpoint and add request signing requirement as a short-term control. We'll follow with RBAC enforcement patch next week.
ETA for short-term controls: 2026-11-09; full RBAC enforcement: 2026-11-17.

I will attach the remediation checklist and a redwood-remediation-log spreadsheet when ready.

Vivek
Head of Infrastructure
Redwood Inference

----
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightWave Assessments <reports@brightwave.com>, Acme Payments Security Ops <secops@acmepayments.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Nov 2026 16:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference - Pen test findings (privilege escalation, secrets exposure)

Team — attaching the evidence bundle requested for Acme and SOC intake. Contents (attachments):
- redwood-remediation-log-20261115.xlsx (detailed checklist, PR/issue links, owner, status)
- evidence-screenshots-priv-esc.zip (sanitized screenshots of role endpoint returning 403 after fix; audit log entries)
- brightwave-pen-test-summary.pdf (original report for reference)

Summary of items provided:
- Secrets: rotated keys (rk-20261107-a, rk-20261107-b), CloudTrail extract showing access before rotation, S3 ACL policy diff, CI check screenshot.
- Privilege escalation: rate-limit and request-signing short-term mitigations deployed, RBAC enforcement PR (GH: redwood/infra#1124) linked in spreadsheet, audit logs showing failed role assignment attempts post-fix.

Jacob / BrightWave / Acme — please confirm these artifacts satisfy the procurement evidence request or indicate any missing items. Mina and I can produce redacted logs if Acme needs narrower extracts.

Next steps pending confirmation:
- Close FND-SECR-07 once Acme acknowledges rotated keys and S3 policy changes.
- Close FND-PRIV-03 after RBAC enforcement is deployed and BrightWave verifies the PoC no longer succeeds (target verification window: 2026-11-18 to 2026-11-20).

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Security Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-remediation-log-20261115.xlsx, evidence-screenshots-priv-esc.zip, brightwave-pen-test-summary.pdf
